_comment: Canonical source-classification lists. Single source of truth for AGGREGATOR_HOSTS (re-syndicator hosts that get quarantined — kept in pipeline but hidden by default) and EXCLUDE_DOMAINS (content-farm / SEO-spam hosts blocked at scan time). Read by scripts/lib/source-classification.mjs (Node) and dashboard-web/lib/source-classification.ts (TypeScript). Do NOT duplicate these arrays in code — import from the loaders.

_format.aggregator_hosts: Re-syndicators of other sites' postings — location/company metadata unreliable, URLs always end '...-new-york-ny-united-states' regardless of real location. Saved to seen-urls.json but tagged source_tier:'aggregator' and hidden by default.
_format.exclude_domains: Content-farm / SEO-spam hosts that emit thin pages with no real JD content. None has ever produced a fit-≥6 role in enrichments.json. Passed to Exa as excludeDomains; blocked subdomain-inclusively for non-Exa tiers via NON_JOB_URL_PATTERNS in scan-jobs.mjs.
